description: Contract version 19 (SIX SERVICES UPDATE, master blueprint section 69, built in section 4B): version 18 plus the events of LynkHR, LynkProject and LynkFiles' approval routes and document requests. Upcaster 18 to 19 in contract/upcasters.v1.json only raises the version.

p256_public_key.description: Uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes), base64url, no padding.

money.description: Integer minor units of the payload's currency.

period.description: A year, a month or a day.

username.description: The shared username rule (blueprint 44 B, core/usernames.py).

side.description: Which side of the service the event belongs to: internal (the workspace) or external (the Storefront). Missing means internal.

ShipmentCreated.note: A shipment exists (LOSHP-): one or more pieces sent by the business's own rider, a partner carrier or an agency.

ShipmentScanned.note: A piece was scanned at a step; the place is a registered hub or pickup point, never a position.

ShipmentHandedOver.note: Custody passed from one party to the next; seal is the hash of the sealed hand-over batch (services/sealing.py), so the Proof Chain can be checked by QR.

ShipmentExceptionRaised.note: Something went wrong, always with the next step the receiver or sender is offered.

DeliveryAttempted.note: A delivery attempt that did not end in a hand-over.

DeliveryRescheduled.note: The receiver chose a new time, a pickup point or a new place (through the cloud, from the tracking page, USSD or text).

ZoneEntered.note: A tracked subject entered a zone; worked out on the device or the cloud, never sent as a position.

ZoneLeft.note: A tracked subject left a zone.

AssetRegistered.note: A vehicle or asset is protected (LOAST-). Hardware is only on demand; the phone is the default tracker.

AssetTripStarted.note: A trip of an asset began (LOTRP-).

AssetTripEnded.note: A trip of an asset ended: whole metres and seconds.

RentalStarted.note: A rental began after the renter was told the vehicle is tracked during the rental; hand-over photos are sealed.

RentalEnded.note: A rental ended; tracking for the renter stops here.

ProtectionAlertRaised.note: A LynkSentry alert (never the platform's AlertRaised). LynkSentry never contacts police by itself.

ProtectionAlertCleared.note: An alert was cleared, for example "Yes, it is me".

SentryIncidentOpened.note: An incident room opened (LOSNT-); it goes to the safety desk. Never the platform status incident (INC).

SentryIncidentClosed.note: An incident was closed by its owner.

LocationShareStarted.note: A person started sharing with people they chose, under a consent record with an end time.

LocationShareEnded.note: A share ended; nothing more is shared from here.

TripPlanSet.note: A trip plan with a check-in deadline; the cloud watches it, so it works even if the phone dies.

TripPlanCheckedIn.note: The person checked in on time.

TripPlanOverdue.note: The deadline passed with no check-in; trusted contacts are told (cloud only).

DeviceLastReport.note: A device's last sealed report before it went quiet, with the reason, so owners know why.

CardRequested.note: A person asked for a card of one group, online only. The form's details (load amount, account, income, consent) go to the licensed partner directly and never into an event.

CardRequestConfirmed.note: Cloud only: the licensed partner issued the card. For a credit card, credit_limit is the integer amount the lender granted.

CardRequestFailed.note: Cloud only: the partner did not issue the card, with the reason shown to the person.

AttendancePersonRegistered.note: A manager registered a person with their set. The ID number and the IDCN made from it go to the protected store, never into an event.

AttendanceSetChanged.note: The manager changed a person's set, with the person's agreement.

AttendanceConsentRecorded.note: The person agreed: the use of their face or finger if in their set, and that sharing a PIN or IDCN is cheating.

BiometricEnrolled.note: Face or Finger was enrolled on the organisation's own device. The pattern stays encrypted on that device and is never in an event.

AttendancePinCreated.note: Cloud only: LynkOmni created the person's 6-digit PIN. The PIN is never in an event.

AttendancePinSent.note: Cloud only: the PIN and IDCN were sent to the person's own contact.

AttendancePinShown.note: Cloud only: a manager pressed Show; every view is recorded.

AttendancePinBlocked.note: The PIN was blocked; it is never used again.

AttendancePinRecreated.note: Cloud only: a new PIN replaced a blocked one.

CheckedIn.note: A person checked in at a registered door device. The time is the door device's.

CheckedOut.note: A person checked out; minutes is the time since check-in.

CheckInFlagged.note: A record was flagged for the manager. It is only a flag, never an accusation.

AttendanceCorrected.note: The manager corrected a record with a reason; the old record is kept.

VisitorSignedIn.note: Door staff signed in a visitor after checking their ID document; with none, the manager allowed it. The ID number is never in an event.

VisitorDecision.note: The manager allowed or refused a visitor without an ID document.

AttendanceRequestRaised.note: Cloud only: the person asked for deletion or raised a dispute from My details; the manager is told.

AttendanceDetailsDeleted.note: Cloud only: all of a person's details were deleted; hours records the law requires stay without personal details.

FireListOpened.note: The fire list of everyone inside was opened.

TicketIssued.note: A ticket was given out. The number shown is section and code; the code is never used twice for that section at that place.

TicketCalled.note: A counter called a ticket (Call next, or Call again).

TicketSentTo.note: Send to: the same ticket and the same arrival time in the next section.

TicketPutBack.note: Reception put a missed ticket back, after the next 3 people.

TicketPriorityMarked.note: Reception marked a ticket as priority.

TicketRunningLate.note: The person moved back a few places, once per ticket.

TicketNotServedToday.note: Cloud only: still waiting at closing; closed by itself.

CounterStateChanged.note: A counter opened, paused or closed.

QueueKeeperChanged.note: Another device in the building became the queue keeper.

TicketCodesReserved.note: Cloud only: a block of codes was set aside for one device to use if it is cut off.

TicketCodesVoided.note: Unused codes of a block were closed with a reason; they are never reused.

SurveySaved.note: A survey or a new version of it was saved; once answers arrive, a change makes a new version.

SurveyApproval.note: An approver approved or sent back a survey.

SurveyStateChanged.note: A survey opened, paused, closed or went into test mode.

SurveyAnswered.note: One answer from a device (kiosk, POS screen, field interview, paper entry). Never who answered an anonymous survey.

SurveyAnswerReceived.note: Cloud only: an answer arrived online (link, chat, text, voice, email). Its content is stored with the answer, never who answered an anonymous survey.

SurveyAnswerChecked.note: Cloud only: the real-answers check; please_check stays apart until the manager decides.

SurveyAnswerDeleted.note: Cloud only: the person deleted their own (non-anonymous) answer.

SurveyOptOut.note: Cloud only: the person pressed Don't ask me again for an organisation.

SurveyCallBack.note: A Call back task for an unhappy person who agreed to be contacted.

SurveyRewardRequested.note: Cloud only: a reward was asked of the payment partner after the answer passed the check.

SurveyCashRewardRecorded.note: A field worker gave a cash reward; integer minor units with the currency.

PanelMembership.note: Cloud only: a person joined or left the LynkSurvey Panel; leaving deletes their panel details.

SurveyResultsVerified.note: Cloud only: the results report and its research record were sealed for the check link.

EmulatorOffered.note: Cloud only: a manager offered an emulator to a device (QR code, Lynk Code or link; or one of the other ways). The code itself is never in an event.

EmulatorRequestAnswered.note: The person at the device tapped Accept or Deny on the connect request.

EmulatorConnected.note: Cloud only: the emulator is connected on the device; a staff emulator now counts against the plan unless it is in practice mode.

EmulatorDisconnected.note: Cloud only: the emulator is switched off on the device. A safe disconnect first takes the device's unsent records; unsent says how many were still to come.

EmulatorConnectAsked.note: A disconnected emulator asked the manager to connect it again (the Connect request button).

DeviceMarkedLost.note: Cloud only: Mark as lost locks every emulator on the device (a wipe stays with the owner alone, identity/device_access.py); found reverses it.

EmulatorSwapStarted.note: Cloud only: a swap began; the old device finishes its work and sends its unsent records first.

EmulatorSwapped.note: Cloud only: the emulator moved to another device with its name, settings and printers.

EmulatorReapprovalNeeded.note: Cloud only: the device was not seen for this many days and must be approved again before it works.

DeviceApprovedAgain.note: Cloud only: a manager approved the device again after it was not seen for a while; it works again.

EmulatorUserChanged.note: A staff member signed in or out of an emulator with their staff PIN (checked on the device; the PIN is never in an event).

EmulatorAssignedTo.note: Cloud only: the manager gave the emulator on this device to a person, several people or a role (customer-facing screens: nobody).

EmulatorSettingsChanged.note: Key tones, press vibration and volume on a device (the manager's default or the user's own choice where allowed).

DeviceHealthReported.note: The device's own health for the live view: online, unsent records, battery and printer, and the morning check at opening.

ScreenViewChanged.note: Cloud only: someone viewed a device's emulator screen to help, only with the user's consent (support through its time-limited consent record); never during a payment, cash count, signature or PIN.

SurveyYouSaidSent.note: Cloud only: the organisation's "You said, we did" message went to the people who answered (told), or was shown on the survey's public page for an anonymous survey.

InvoiceIssued.note: Cloud only: LynkInv issued an invoice (public id LOINV-; the printed number is a separate series). It never changes after this; the fix is a credit note.

CreditNoteIssued.note: Cloud only: a credit note corrects an issued invoice (an LOINV- record of kind credit_note with its own printed series).

PeriodClosed.note: Cloud only: the period is locked in LynkAcc; later changes go into the next open period.

DealStageChanged.note: A deal moved to another stage in LynkCRM; field sales can do it offline and it syncs later.

ConversationCardSent.note: Cloud only: a card from its own service (an invoice with its pay link, a quote, a receipt) was sent into a customer conversation (LOCNV-); the card follows its service's rules and states.

AdEarningsRecorded.note: Cloud only: a merchant's share of ad earnings for a period, from validated impressions only (at least half on screen for a second); posted to LynkAcc as income. Placeholders until legal sign-off.

DocumentFiled.note: A file kept in LynkFiles under the record it belongs to, with that service's access rules; a bill or receipt is read into a draft entry a person confirms.

VoteRollImported.note: Cloud only: a vote's roll (LOVOT-) was built from the organisation's members with its recorded consent; only the count is in the event, never a voter's name.

ExchangeSettled.note: Cloud only: the licensed partner settled a conversion of amount (in currency) into to_amount (in to_currency); LynkOmni never holds the money. Posts the conversion and any rate gain or loss to LynkAcc.

ConversationOpened.note: A conversation (LOCNV-) was opened: customer and business, Storefront or support; never personal, group or staff-to-staff chat. 'Chat about this' names the record it is about.

MessagePosted.note: A message was written (queued on the device, sent when it leaves). The text is never in the event: it is kept in the message store, already masked on the device (card numbers, PINs and codes), and the event carries its sha256 only. message_id is the device's own id, so a repeat is dropped.

MessageEdited.note: The author fixed their own text message within the edit window (15 minutes); it is marked edited and the first version is kept for disputes.

MessageStateChanged.note: Cloud only: the message reached the other side (accepted), was seen or played (confirmed; never written for a reader who turned 'seen' off) or failed. A device never writes these.

ConversationRouted.note: Cloud only: who gets the chat and why, from the routing register (LynkAssist first, the fast lane, the same helper, language, least busy, the owner's team rules). Answers 'Why did I get this chat?' and 'Who is helping me?'.

ConversationHandedOver.note: Cloud only: a warm hand-over; the person who joins gets a short summary and the full history, so the customer never repeats themselves.

ConversationClosed.note: A conversation was closed; one new message reopens it. Never deletes anything.

ConversationReported.note: Block and report in one tap; the report goes to the safety desk from either side.

BillRecorded.note: A supplier bill was entered (by hand, photo, email or e-invoice) into Bills to pay. A photo or file stays in the document store; the event carries its sha256. It waits for approval before any payment.

account.description: A global account code of the chart of accounts.

BillApproved.note: Cloud only: one approval step of a bill, by amount and department; the person who entered the bill never approves it.

BillPaymentConfirmed.note: Cloud only: a bill (or part of it) is paid. An electronic payment is written only when the licensed provider confirms it; LynkOmni never holds the money.

ExpenseClaimSubmitted.note: A staff member submitted an expense claim: a receipt, mileage (distance in thousandths of a kilometre) or daily allowances at the country pack's rate.

account.description: A global account code of the chart of accounts.

ExpenseClaimApproved.note: Cloud only: an expense claim was approved by someone other than the claimant; it is repaid with wages or by payout.

AssetAdded.note: Cloud only: an asset joined the register (public id LOAST-, the same record whether or not LynkMotion tracks it).

DepreciationPosted.note: Cloud only: the asset's loss of value for a period, from its schedule (the schedule ends exactly at the value left).

JournalPosted.note: Cloud only: a balanced journal of named accounts; a sensitive kind is prepared by one person and approved by another; nothing posts on a locked date.

account.description: A global account code of the chart of accounts.

LockDateSet.note: Cloud only: nothing posts on or before the lock date; moving it back needs two people.

DocumentIssued.note: Cloud only: LynkInv issued a document other than an invoice or credit note (those keep InvoiceIssued and CreditNoteIssued): a quote, pro-forma, sales order, delivery note, receipt, debit note, statement of account or a buyer-issued invoice where the law allows. It keeps its public id from core/ids.py and never changes.

InvoiceReminderSent.note: Cloud only: a reminder went out on a channel the customer agreed to, in their language, outside quiet hours; once per step.

PromiseToPayRecorded.note: The customer promised to pay by a date; reminders pause until the day after it.

InvoiceDisputed.note: A line or amount of an invoice is disputed; reminders pause for that amount until it is resolved.

InvoiceWrittenOff.note: Cloud only: an amount nobody will pay is written off to bad debts, prepared by one person and approved by another.

CreditBalanceChanged.note: Cloud only: a customer's credit balance from an overpayment grew, was used on an invoice or was refunded through the provider; it is never income.

InstalmentPlanAgreed.note: Cloud only: what is owed on an invoice is split exactly into dated parts.

SubscriptionChanged.note: Cloud only: a subscription (LOSUB-) changed; an upgrade or downgrade is charged or credited for the whole days left in the period.

CustomerRecordCreated.note: A LynkCRM record was created (offline too). Names and contact details stay in the record store and the PII vault; the event carries none. Version 15 adds the kind payee (LynkExchange payees).

CustomerRecordsMerged.note: Cloud only: likely duplicates were merged into the oldest record, keeping every activity; it can be undone for 30 days.

CustomerHandedOver.note: Cloud only: a customer moved to another owner when staff changed; every past note and activity stays.

CaseOpened.note: A service case was opened with its priority; its promised first answer follows the priority (or the organisation's own times on Max).

CaseStateChanged.note: Cloud only: a case moved on; a case past its promise is marked late, never hidden.

ContactConsentChanged.note: A person gave or withdrew consent for one channel; withdrawing stops messages at once.

DataRequestReceived.note: Cloud only: a person asked to see, correct, delete or move their data; it is answered by the due date of the country's rule.

VisitCheckedIn.note: A field visit happened (or was missed), offline too. A position is never recorded, only that the visit happened.

EInvoiceStateChanged.note: Cloud only: the tax office's network (provider ledger e_invoice_network) answered for an invoice. Only the network's answer writes accepted, confirmed or failed.

VoteCreated.note: Cloud only: an organiser set up a vote with its kind, counting method and assurance level; a branch vote of a federation names the federation's vote.

VoteRulesLocked.note: Cloud only: the rules locked when voting opened; their fingerprint is published.

VoteRulesChanged.note: Cloud only: a change after the rules locked, approved by two authorised people with a stated reason; it shows in the public log.

TrusteeKeyPublished.note: Cloud only: a trustee published the public side of their key part in the key ceremony, with its proof checked. The key part itself is never in an event.

VoteRollLocked.note: Cloud only: the final roll locked with its own fingerprint after the period for voters to check their entry.

VoteOpened.note: Cloud only: voting opened under the trustees' joint key.

BallotCast.note: A locked ballot joined the public list under its tracking code. A polling-place device may cast offline and send sealed batches later. Never the choice, never who cast it, never when.

BallotChallenged.note: A voter challenged the device to prove it locked the ballot honestly; a challenged ballot is opened for that voter and never cast.

BallotReplaced.note: Cloud only: where the rules allow, an earlier ballot no longer counts because the voter voted again or in person.

VoteReminderSent.note: Cloud only: a round of reminders went to voters on the roll who have not voted yet; who they are is never in the event.

VoteClosed.note: Cloud only: voting closed; the number of ballots and the head of the public list are published. Nobody saw totals before this.

BallotsShuffled.note: Cloud only: ballots to be read one by one were shuffled and re-locked with a proof anyone can check.

TallyPublished.note: Cloud only: the trustees opened the totals together; the results and every proof are published by fingerprint.

VoteResultCertified.note: Cloud only: the official result was signed; sealed is true only when the trust-service partner sealed and time-stamped it.

VoteAnomalyFlagged.note: Cloud only: an unusual pattern was flagged to the organiser and observers. They decide, never LynkOmni; a flag is never an accusation.

VoteCredentialReissued.note: Cloud only: a voter got a new link or code and the old one was cancelled; who it was is never in the event.

DecisionRecorded.note: Cloud only: the governance home's register of decisions gained one, from a vote or a meeting, with how many actions are owed; who must act is kept in the register, never in the event.

MinutesSigned.note: Cloud only: the minutes of a meeting were signed electronically by everyone who had to sign; the text stays in LynkFiles, the event keeps its fingerprint.

SignatureRequested.note: Cloud only: a document was sent for signing to a number of signers, in order or together; who they are is never in the event.

DocumentSigned.note: Cloud only: the signer whose turn it was signed. An identity-checked or qualified signature is written only when its partner confirms.

SignatureDeclined.note: Cloud only: a signer refused; the request stops and the sender is told.

SignatureCompleted.note: Cloud only: every signer signed; the signed document's fingerprint and the fingerprint of its verification code are kept.

ShareLinkCreated.note: Cloud only: a share link was made with its rights and end date; the address and any password are never in the event.

ShareLinkStopped.note: Cloud only: a share link stopped working.

FileVersionAdded.note: A new version of a kept file (an edited form or a new scan); earlier versions stay and can be restored. May be made offline on a device.

LegalHoldChanged.note: Cloud only: a legal hold was set or lifted; nothing under hold is changed or deleted.

FileDeleted.note: Cloud only: a file was deleted by its owner or at the end of its keeping time, never while under legal hold.

BookingConfirmed.note: Cloud only: a booking was confirmed with its kind, place, time, number of guests, where the customer came from and its total. The customer is only their LynkCRM record's id, when the business keeps one.

BookingPaid.note: Cloud only: the provider confirmed a payment for a booking, in full, a deposit or the balance. Cash at the venue is PaymentRecorded cash_received, as everywhere.

BookingCheckedIn.note: The customer arrived and was checked in, at the front desk or by self check-in; works offline at the desk.

BookingCancelled.note: A booking was cancelled, with the fee kept under the cancelling rule shown before booking (zero when none applies).

BookingNoShow.note: Cloud only: nobody came; the no-show fee kept is only the one shown before booking.

BookingRefunded.note: Cloud only: the provider confirmed a refund for a booking.

BookingCommissionRecorded.note: Cloud only: LynkOmni's commission on a booking LynkBooking brought, taken by the provider from the payout; never on the business's own customers.

ExchangeOrderPlaced.note: Cloud only: an exchange order was placed with the licensed partner at one full price (LynkOmni's part in basis points). for_id names the LynkInv invoice or LynkAcc bill it pays. A practice order never moves money.

ExchangeOrderPaid.note: Cloud only: the licensed partner confirmed it received the money for the order.

ExchangeOrderFailed.note: Cloud only: the order did not go through; the partner alone decides a refusal.

ExchangeRefunded.note: Cloud only: the licensed partner confirmed it sent the money back.

ExchangeProofIssued.note: Cloud only: a proof of exchange was kept in LynkFiles with a code anyone can check; the code itself is never in the event.

GiftCardSold.note: A gift card was sold or topped up at the till or online. The money is owed to the holder (LynkAcc 2200), never held by LynkOmni. Works offline; an electronic payment is in the clearing account until the provider confirms it.

StoreCreditIssued.note: Store credit was given to a customer for a return, as cashback or as goodwill; it is owed to the customer (LynkAcc 2510). VoucherRedeemed spends it.

DepositTaken.note: A deposit was taken for a pre-order, a special order, a rental or a layaway; it is received in advance (LynkAcc 2500) until it settles. Works offline; never blocked.

DepositSettled.note: A deposit (or part of it) was used for the sale, kept under terms shown before paying, or returned in cash. An electronic return is DepositRefunded, written by the cloud.

DepositRefunded.note: Cloud only: the provider confirmed it returned a deposit electronically.

StoredValueConflictFlagged.note: Cloud only: a gift card or store credit was spent below nothing (sales made offline are never blocked); shown to the owner, nothing is posted twice.

PaymentSettled.note: Cloud only: a line of the provider's settlement report: the payment, the provider's fee and LynkOmni's part, as the provider reports them (LynkAcc 6100).

PaymentMatched.note: Cloud only: a provider's payment was matched to its sale, invoice or booking: by its reference, confirmed by a person, or by the Plus automation (undoable).

PaymentMatchUndone.note: Cloud only: a match was undone; the payment is listed as unmatched again.

ProviderPayoutScheduled.note: Cloud only: the provider said when a payout will arrive in the shop's own bank or wallet.

ProviderPayoutArrived.note: Cloud only: the provider confirmed the payout was paid (LynkAcc 1020 from 1010).

BetRequested.note: The counter asked the operator to take a bet. Online it is sent at once; offline it is a queued slip (never a ticket) and only where the operator switched offline slips on, never for live betting. Never on credit.

BetConfirmed.note: Cloud only: the operator took the bet and gave its ticket reference; the ticket prints. Stake cash is held for the operator.

BetFailed.note: Cloud only: the operator refused the bet. A queued slip that is refused is refunded in full (refund_due).

BetTicketChecked.note: A ticket was scanned and the operator's answer shown. Only the operator's amount is ever paid.

BetPayoutLockAsked.note: The counter asked the operator to lock a payout before any cash leaves the drawer. Online only.

BetPayoutLocked.note: Cloud only: the operator locked the payout; the ticket can never be paid again, a copy included.

BetPayoutLockFailed.note: Cloud only: the operator refused the lock; nothing is paid.

BetPaidOut.note: The winnings were handed over after the operator's lock (state confirmed).

BetReferred.note: A big win was referred to the operator's head office. The photos of the ticket and ID go only to the operator; the event keeps a reference.

BetReferralAnswered.note: Cloud only: the operator moved a referral a step; only its answers move the tracker.

BetCancelAsked.note: A manager asked to cancel a bet within the operator's allowed time, before any game started. Online only.

BetCancelled.note: Cloud only: the operator cancelled the bet; the stake is returned.

BetDisputeOpened.note: A customer disputes a result; the ticket and its history go to the operator.

BetDisputeAnswered.note: Cloud only: the operator answered a dispute.

BetSettlementRecorded.note: Cloud only: the operator's statement for a period: stakes held for it, payouts, the shop's commission and what is owed either way. Posted once to LynkAcc; differences are flagged.

BetFlagRaised.note: Cloud only: a Please check flag for the owner and the operator. Never an accusation and never a block.

BetShopStatusChanged.note: Cloud only: the operator approved, paused or ended this shop through the Partner Hub.

TrackingStepMarked.note: A business's own extra step on a tracked item, marked on a device (offline too). Never changes the five-state chip or an ending; unknown steps are ignored by the engine.

StaffRecordCreated.note: A staff record (LOSTF-) in LynkHR. The name and contact stay in the PII vault; the event carries the kind of worker only.

StaffChecklistStepDone.note: A joining or leaving step done (offline too). Final pay figures go to LynkAcc only after notice, equipment back and access closed.

StaffLeft.note: A staff member's last day, after the leaving checklist's musts are done.

LeaveRequested.note: A leave request in half days (offline too). A clash is shown, never a refusal.

LeaveAnswered.note: The manager's answer to a leave request (offline too); never the person who asked.

LeaveCancelled.note: A leave request withdrawn by the person or cancelled before it starts.

ReviewCycleOpened.note: A review cycle opened by HR with the kinds of answers it asks for.

ReviewAnswered.note: One answer given in a review cycle (its words stay in LynkHR; peer and upward answers carry nobody).

ReviewSignedOff.note: A person's review signed off by the named manager; the person can ask for a human review of it.

PayChangeProposed.note: A pay change proposed (figures only; payroll runs in LynkAcc).

PayChangeApproved.note: A pay change approved by a different person (and a third when over the budget).

PayrollFiguresSent.note: One period's payroll figures handed to LynkAcc: totals only, never a person's pay in the event.

HrCaseOpened.note: An HR case (grievance, discipline, investigation, concern, help desk). An anonymous concern carries nobody.

HrCaseStepMoved.note: An HR case moved to its next step, each with its deadline; a decision is always a named person's.

ProjectCreated.note: A project (LOPRJ-) from a template or blank (offline too). Its name stays in LynkProject.

TaskCreated.note: A task (LOTSK-) in a project, captured any way (offline too). Its title and notes never travel in the event.

TaskStateChanged.note: A task moved (offline too); done only when what it waits on is done.

TaskWaitAdded.note: A task now waits on another task; never itself and never in a circle.

TimeLogged.note: Time on a project in whole minutes (offline too).

TimeSheetAnswered.note: A week's time sheet approved or sent back by a manager, never the person who logged it.

ProjectTimeBilled.note: Approved billable time put on a LynkInv invoice, once.

ProjectCostRecorded.note: A cost or purchase for a project, posted through LynkAcc.

ChangeRequestRaised.note: A change request on a project (offline too).

ChangeRequestDecided.note: A change request accepted or refused by the named person.

ApprovalRouteStarted.note: An approval route for a document, bill, expense or invoice, with its approvers in order.

ApprovalStepAnswered.note: One approver's answer on a route; never the person who sent it.

DocumentRequested.note: A request for someone to upload a document into a folder (a staff file, a certificate).

DocumentRequestAnswered.note: The requested document arrived (it is a DocumentFiled) and was checked, or the request was closed.
